name: chart-card-01
title: Chart Card 01 - A Titled Panel Holding One Figure
description: A titled panel holding one figure, the key for it, the controls that act on it, and the figures the card states about it. The figure is a slot rather than a prop with a mark, because a Block that named a chart type would be choosing the caller's data shape and a chart is the one thing on an operate screen a consumer most often replaces. The card does not check that the figure is readable as numbers, because a Block cannot see inside a slot, and this documentation says so rather than pretending it verified it.
